KV-cache compatible decision-model based routing on Perplexity Orchestrator API

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Denis Yarats (@denisyarats); megjelent: 2026-11-17T20:23:28+00:00; link: https://x.com/denisyarats/status/2122787728672645610; média: videó, 0 másodperc]
we are launching the Orchestrator API: 45+ open-weight and proprietary models in one api, with automatic provider failover and unified billing.

general model routing doesn't really work in practice: it breaks the kv cache and is usually overfit to a few benchmarks. so we designed our routing api differently: it's kv cache friendly, and you decide which models to use for which tasks.

one example: fable 5.2 often refuses benign security and biology tasks, so we route those (and anything after a refusal) to gpt-6.1 sol. on terminal-bench 4.1 this goes from 38 to 41 solved tasks out of 63.
